subject: Science
title: NCEA Level 1 Science
note: NCEA achievement standards current for 2026. Each standard is assessed internally (during the year) or externally (end-of-year NZQA exam). NZ is replacing NCEA with new qualifications from 2028–2030, so check for changes each year.
